ev.q: On August 31, 2002, a boy aged 13 years residing in Franklin County, Tennessee, died from rabies encephalitis
Four household members and one other family member received postexposure prophylaxis (PEP) for rabies
In addition, 18 health-care workers who had contact with the patient received PEP.
